about: cym_for_kor step 1 (cs #764): Korean known-side seed drafts against Hadau Creiddiol North 1-668 (live: cym_nv2_for_eng S1001-S1668). DRAFT for Kai; nothing written to any course row.

seeds.welsh: dw i isio siarad Cymraeg efo chdi rŵan
seeds.english: I want to speak Welsh with you now
seeds.korean: 저는 지금 당신과 웨일스어로 이야기하고 싶어요
seeds.note: siarad = 이야기하다 throughout (deud = 말하다), so speak and say never share a Korean verb

seeds.welsh: dw i’n trio dysgu
seeds.english: I'm trying to learn
seeds.korean: 저는 배우려고 노력하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: sut i siarad mor aml â phosib
seeds.english: how to speak as often as possible
seeds.korean: 가능한 한 자주 이야기하는 방법
seeds.note: fragment in Welsh and English; no 해요 ending possible

seeds.welsh: sut i ddeud rhywbeth yn y Gymraeg
seeds.english: how to say something in Welsh
seeds.korean: 웨일스어로 무언가를 말하는 방법

seeds.welsh: dw i’n mynd i ymarfer siarad efo rhywun arall
seeds.english: I'm going to practise speaking with someone else
seeds.korean: 저는 다른 사람과 이야기하는 연습을 할 거예요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n trio cofio gair
seeds.english: I'm trying to remember a word
seeds.korean: 저는 단어 하나를 기억하려고 노력하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dw i isio trio mor galed ag y medra i heddiw
seeds.english: I want to try as hard as I can today
seeds.korean: 저는 오늘 제가 할 수 있는 만큼 열심히 노력하고 싶어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n mynd i drio esbonio be’ dw i’n ei olygu
seeds.english: I'm going to try to explain what I mean
seeds.korean: 저는 제 말이 무슨 뜻인지 설명하려고 노력할 거예요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n siarad tipyn bach o Gymraeg rŵan
seeds.english: I speak a little Welsh now
seeds.korean: 저는 이제 웨일스어를 조금 해요
seeds.note: siarad + language with no partner = 웨일스어를 하다 (natural Korean); rŵan = 지금/이제

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn siŵr os medra i gofio’r frawddeg gyfan
seeds.english: I'm not sure if I can remember the whole sentence
seeds.korean: 저는 문장 전체를 기억할 수 있을지 확실하지 않아요
seeds.note: ddim yn siŵr = 확실하지 않아요, kept apart from ddim yn gwybod = 몰라요

seeds.welsh: liciwn i fedru siarad ar ôl i ti orffen
seeds.english: I'd like to be able to speak after you finish
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 끝낸 후에 이야기할 수 있으면 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: fyddwn i ddim yn licio dyfalu be’ sy’n mynd i ddigwydd ’fory
seeds.english: I wouldn't like to guess what's going to happen tomorrow
seeds.korean: 저는 내일 무슨 일이 일어날지 추측하고 싶지는 않을 것 같아요
seeds.note: fyddwn i ddim yn licio = -고 싶지는 않을 것 같아요, kept apart from dw i ddim isio = -고 싶지 않아요 (eng_for_kor has these as a ZUT pair)

seeds.welsh: ti’n siarad Cymraeg yn dda iawn
seeds.english: you speak Welsh very well
seeds.korean: 당신은 웨일스어를 아주 잘 해요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti’n siarad Cymraeg trwy’r dydd?
seeds.english: do you speak Welsh all day?
seeds.korean: 당신은 하루 종일 웨일스어를 하나요?

seeds.welsh: a dw i isio i ti siarad Cymraeg efo fi ’fory
seeds.english: and I want you to speak Welsh with me tomorrow
seeds.korean: 그리고 저는 당신이 내일 저와 웨일스어로 이야기하기를 원해요

seeds.welsh: mae o isio dod yn ôl efo pawb arall nes ymlaen
seeds.english: he wants to come back with everyone else later on
seeds.korean: 그는 나중에 다른 모든 사람들과 함께 돌아오고 싶어해요

seeds.welsh: mae hi isio ffeindio allan be’ ydy’r ateb
seeds.english: she wants to find out what the answer is
seeds.korean: 그녀는 답이 무엇인지 알아내고 싶어해요

seeds.welsh: dan ni isio cyfarfod am chwech o’r gloch heno
seeds.english: we want to meet at six o'clock this evening
seeds.korean: 우리는 오늘 저녁 여섯 시에 만나고 싶어요
seeds.note: heno = 오늘 저녁 / 오늘 밤, both harmless

seeds.welsh: ond dw i ddim isio stopio siarad
seeds.english: but I don't want to stop talking
seeds.korean: 하지만 저는 이야기하는 것을 멈추고 싶지 않아요

seeds.welsh: ti isio dysgu ei enw fo’n gyflym
seeds.english: you want to learn his name quickly
seeds.korean: 당신은 그의 이름을 빨리 배우고 싶어요
seeds.note: statement; the question form would be 싶나요?

seeds.welsh: pam wyt ti’n dysgu ei henw hi?
seeds.english: why are you learning her name?
seeds.korean: 당신은 왜 그녀의 이름을 배우고 있어요?

seeds.welsh: achos dw i isio cyfarfod pobl sy’n siarad Cymraeg
seeds.english: because I want to meet people who speak Welsh
seeds.korean: 왜냐하면 저는 웨일스어를 하는 사람들을 만나고 싶기 때문이에요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n mynd i ddechrau siarad mwy cyn bo hir
seeds.english: I'm going to start talking more soon
seeds.korean: 저는 곧 더 많이 이야기하기 시작할 거예요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn mynd i fedru cofio’n hawdd
seeds.english: I'm not going to be able to remember easily
seeds.korean: 저는 쉽게 기억할 수 없을 거예요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti’n mynd i helpu fi cyn i mi orfod mynd?
seeds.english: are you going to help me before I have to go?
seeds.korean: 당신은 제가 가야 하기 전에 저를 도와줄 건가요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n licio teimlo fel taswn i bron yn barod i fynd
seeds.english: I like feeling as if I'm nearly ready to go
seeds.korean: 저는 거의 갈 준비가 된 것처럼 느끼는 것을 좋아해요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn licio cymryd gormod o amser i ateb
seeds.english: I don't like taking too much time to answer
seeds.korean: 저는 대답하는 데 시간을 너무 많이 들이는 것을 좋아하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: mae’n ddefnyddiol dechrau siarad cyn gynted ag y medri di
seeds.english: it's useful to start talking as soon as you can
seeds.korean: 당신이 할 수 있는 한 빨리 이야기하기 시작하는 것이 유용해요
seeds.note: generic you (medri di) kept as 당신; natural Korean drops it

seeds.welsh: dw i’n edrych ymlaen at siarad yn well cyn gynted ag y medra i
seeds.english: I'm looking forward to speaking better as soon as I can
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 할 수 있는 한 빨리 더 잘 이야기하게 되기를 기대하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: o’n i isio gofyn rhywbeth i ti ddoe
seeds.english: I wanted to ask you something yesterday
seeds.korean: 저는 어제 당신에게 무언가를 물어보고 싶었어요

seeds.welsh: oeddat ti isio siarad efo fi heno
seeds.english: you wanted to speak with me tonight
seeds.korean: 당신은 오늘 밤 저와 이야기하고 싶었어요

seeds.welsh: oeddat ti isio dangos rhywbeth i mi?
seeds.english: did you want to show me something?
seeds.korean: 당신은 저에게 무언가를 보여주고 싶었나요?

seeds.welsh: pa mor hir wyt ti ’di bod yn dysgu Cymraeg?
seeds.english: how long have you been learning Welsh?
seeds.korean: 당신은 웨일스어를 얼마나 오랫동안 배워 왔어요?

seeds.welsh: dydy o ddim isio bod yn ddistaw pan mae pobl eraill yma
seeds.english: he doesn't want to be quiet when other people are here
seeds.korean: 그는 다른 사람들이 여기 있을 때 조용히 있고 싶어하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dydy hi ddim isio darllen unrhyw beth pnawn ’ma
seeds.english: she doesn't want to read anything this afternoon
seeds.korean: 그녀는 오늘 오후에 아무것도 읽고 싶어하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dan ni ddim isio torri ar draws y stori
seeds.english: we don't want to interrupt the story
seeds.korean: 우리는 이야기를 끊고 싶지 않아요

seeds.welsh: wnes i ddechrau meddwl amdano fo’n ofalus mis diwetha’
seeds.english: I started to think about it carefully last month
seeds.korean: 저는 지난달에 그것에 대해 신중하게 생각하기 시작했어요

seeds.welsh: dw i wedi bod yn dysgu am tua wythnos
seeds.english: I've been learning for about a week
seeds.korean: 저는 일주일 정도 배워 왔어요

seeds.welsh: ond dw i wedi blino dipyn bach bore ’ma
seeds.english: but I'm a little tired this morning
seeds.korean: 하지만 저는 오늘 아침에 조금 피곤해요

seeds.welsh: sut wyt ti’n teimlo ar hyn o bryd?
seeds.english: how do you feel at the moment?
seeds.korean: 당신은 지금 이 순간 기분이 어때요?
seeds.note: ar hyn o bryd = 지금 이 순간, because bare 지금 is rŵan; without this the prompt admits rŵan or ar hyn o bryd

seeds.welsh: dw i’n teimlo’n iawn, ond dw i’n dechrau blino
seeds.english: I feel okay, but I'm starting to feel tired
seeds.korean: 저는 기분이 괜찮아요, 하지만 피곤해지기 시작하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: o’n i’n dechrau teimlo’n well na neithiwr
seeds.english: I was starting to feel better than last night
seeds.korean: 저는 어젯밤보다 기분이 나아지기 시작하고 있었어요

seeds.welsh: do’n i ddim yn meddwl am sut i ateb
seeds.english: I wasn't thinking about how to answer
seeds.korean: 저는 어떻게 대답할지에 대해 생각하고 있지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: neu os dw i angen gwella
seeds.english: or if I need to improve
seeds.korean: 아니면 제가 나아질 필요가 있는지

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim angen gwybod popeth
seeds.english: I don't need to know everything
seeds.korean: 저는 모든 것을 알 필요가 없어요

seeds.welsh: ond dw i ddim yn poeni am wneud camgymeriadau
seeds.english: but I don't worry about making mistakes
seeds.korean: 하지만 저는 실수하는 것에 대해 걱정하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: achos dw i’n meddwl fod o’n beth da i wneud camgymeriadau
seeds.english: because I think that it's a good thing to make mistakes
seeds.korean: 왜냐하면 저는 실수하는 것이 좋은 일이라고 생각하기 때문이에요

seeds.welsh: does dim ots gen i am wneud camgymeriadau
seeds.english: I don't care about making mistakes
seeds.korean: 저는 실수하는 것은 상관없어요
seeds.note: does dim ots gen i = 상관없어요

seeds.welsh: mae o fel hyn, os ti’n gwybod be’ dw i’n ei olygu
seeds.english: it's like this, if you know what I mean
seeds.korean: 이런 거예요, 당신이 제 말이 무슨 뜻인지 안다면요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn trio gorffen mor gyflym â phosib
seeds.english: I'm not trying to finish as quickly as possible
seeds.korean: 저는 가능한 한 빨리 끝내려고 노력하고 있지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n mwynhau gwneud pethau diddorol efo fy ffrindiau
seeds.english: I enjoy doing interesting things with my friends
seeds.korean: 저는 제 친구들과 흥미로운 일들을 하는 것을 즐겨요

seeds.welsh: oedd o isio sgwennu llythyr at ei ffrind wythnos diwetha’
seeds.english: he wanted to write a letter to his friend last week
seeds.korean: 그는 지난주에 그의 친구에게 편지를 쓰고 싶어했어요

seeds.welsh: oedd hi isio rhoi ei lythyr o yn ei bag hi
seeds.english: she wanted to put his letter in her bag
seeds.korean: 그녀는 그의 편지를 그녀의 가방에 넣고 싶어했어요

seeds.welsh: oeddan ni isio rhoi ychydig mwy o amser i ti
seeds.english: we wanted to give you a little more time
seeds.korean: 우리는 당신에게 시간을 조금 더 주고 싶었어요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn mwynhau deffro pan wnes i ddim cysgu’n dda iawn
seeds.english: I don't enjoy waking up when I didn't sleep very well
seeds.korean: 저는 잠을 아주 잘 자지 못했을 때 깨는 것을 즐기지 않아요

seeds.welsh: fel medra i gofio sut i ddeud ychydig o eiriau
seeds.english: so I can remember how to say a few words
seeds.korean: 제가 몇몇 단어를 어떻게 말하는지 기억할 수 있도록
seeds.note: fel = so that (purpose clause, a fragment); English "so I can" could also read as "therefore"; translated the Welsh

seeds.welsh: fedra i ddim cofio sut i ddeud be’ o’n i isio deud
seeds.english: I can't remember how to say what I wanted to say
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 말하고 싶었던 것을 어떻게 말하는지 기억할 수 없어요

seeds.welsh: mae’n ddiddorol pan ti’n dallt digon o eiriau
seeds.english: it's interesting when you understand enough words
seeds.korean: 당신이 충분한 단어를 이해할 때 흥미로워요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n gwybod sut i wneud be’ dw i angen gwneud wythnos nesa’
seeds.english: I know how to do what I need to do next week
seeds.korean: 저는 다음 주에 할 필요가 있는 일을 어떻게 하는지 알아요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn gwybod sut i ddeud digon o eiriau gwahanol hyd yn hyn
seeds.english: I don't know how to say enough different words yet
seeds.korean: 저는 아직 충분히 다양한 단어를 어떻게 말하는지 몰라요

seeds.welsh: fedri di ddeud hynna eto bach yn arafach?
seeds.english: could you say that again a little more slowly?
seeds.korean: 당신은 그걸 조금 더 천천히 다시 말해 줄 수 있나요?

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn siŵr os medra i helpu chdi ar yr un pryd
seeds.english: I'm not sure if I can help you at the same time
seeds.korean: 저는 당신을 동시에 도울 수 있을지 확실하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti’n siŵr bod dim ots gen ti helpu fi?
seeds.english: are you sure you don't mind helping me?
seeds.korean: 당신은 저를 도와주는 게 상관없다고 확신하나요?

seeds.welsh: dydy dysgu Cymraeg ddim yn hawdd ond mae’n hwyl
seeds.english: learning Welsh isn't easy but it is fun
seeds.korean: 웨일스어를 배우는 것은 쉽지 않지만 재미있어요

seeds.welsh: mae’n bwysig cymryd amser i brofi dy hun
seeds.english: it's important to take time to test yourself
seeds.korean: 당신 자신을 시험해 볼 시간을 갖는 것이 중요해요
seeds.note: generic you (dy hun) as 당신 자신

seeds.welsh: dydy hi ddim yn anodd ffeindio’r ateb
seeds.english: it's not difficult to find the answer
seeds.korean: 답을 찾아내는 것은 어렵지 않아요
seeds.note: ffeindio = 찾아내다, chwilio am = 찾다 (seed 68); kept apart so 찾다 is not two Welsh verbs

seeds.welsh: pam wyt ti isio stopio?
seeds.english: why do you want to stop?
seeds.korean: 당신은 왜 멈추고 싶어요?

seeds.welsh: be’ wyt ti’n chwilio amdano?
seeds.english: what are you looking for?
seeds.korean: 당신은 무엇을 찾고 있어요?

seeds.welsh: doedd o ddim isio edrych ar ôl y ci ifanc trwy’r pnawn
seeds.english: he didn't want to look after the young dog all afternoon
seeds.korean: 그는 오후 내내 그 어린 개를 돌보고 싶어하지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: doedd hi ddim isio deud wrtha i lle oedd o
seeds.english: she didn't want to tell me where it was
seeds.korean: 그녀는 그것이 어디에 있었는지 저에게 말하고 싶어하지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: doeddan ni ddim isio gadael i neb glywed y gwir
seeds.english: we didn't want to let anyone hear the truth
seeds.korean: 우리는 아무도 진실을 듣게 하고 싶지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl bo’ ti’n gwneud yn dda iawn
seeds.english: I think that you're doing very well
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 아주 잘하고 있다고 생각해요

seeds.welsh: diolch yn fawr, ond mae gen i fwy i ddysgu
seeds.english: thank you very much, but I've got more to learn
seeds.korean: 정말 감사해요, 하지만 저는 더 배울 것이 있어요

seeds.welsh: diolch yn fawr am helpu fi i ddallt
seeds.english: thank you very much for helping me to understand
seeds.korean: 제가 이해하도록 도와줘서 정말 감사해요
seeds.note: no 당신: the Welsh has no ti either

seeds.welsh: oes gen ti fwy i ddysgu?
seeds.english: have you got more to learn?
seeds.korean: 당신은 더 배울 것이 있나요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n hapus iawn efo faint dw i wedi dysgu’n barod
seeds.english: I'm very happy with how much I've learnt already
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 이미 얼마나 많이 배웠는지에 아주 만족해요
seeds.note: hapus efo = 만족하다 here; elsewhere hapus = 기쁘다. Two Korean for one Welsh is the harmless direction

seeds.welsh: dw i’n synnu pa mor gyflym dw i’n dechrau dallt
seeds.english: I'm surprised at how quickly I'm starting to understand
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 얼마나 빨리 이해하기 시작하고 있는지 놀라워요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn dallt be’ ddudest ti
seeds.english: I don't understand what you said
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 말한 것을 이해하지 못해요

seeds.welsh: pryd wnest ti ddechrau dysgu?
seeds.english: when did you start to learn?
seeds.korean: 당신은 언제 배우기 시작했어요?

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn siŵr pryd fydda i’n barod
seeds.english: I'm not sure when I'll be ready
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 언제 준비가 될지 확실하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: pryd wyt ti isio dechrau?
seeds.english: when do you want to start?
seeds.korean: 당신은 언제 시작하고 싶어요?

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn mynd i aros amdanat ti. pam ddim?
seeds.english: I'm not going to wait for you. Why not?
seeds.korean: 저는 당신을 기다리지 않을 거예요. 왜요?
seeds.note: pam ddim? (why not) has no clean short Korean; 왜요? would also fit pam? Alternative: 왜 안 기다려요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n cytuno efo be’ ddudest ti am dy ffrind
seeds.english: I agree with what you said about your friend
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 당신의 친구에 대해 말한 것에 동의해요
seeds.note: two 당신 in one line reads heavy; kept for the dy/ti

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn cytuno efo be’ ddudodd o am fy ffrind
seeds.english: I don't agree with what he said about my friend
seeds.korean: 저는 그가 제 친구에 대해 말한 것에 동의하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn nabod y bobl ’na
seeds.english: I don't know those people
seeds.korean: 저는 그 사람들을 몰라요
seeds.note: nabod (know a person) and gwybod (know a fact) are both 알다; the object decides. Course-wide note

seeds.welsh: doedd o ddim yn bosib, yn anffodus
seeds.english: it wasn't possible, unfortunately
seeds.korean: 안타깝게도 그것은 가능하지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: pobl dw i ddim yn nabod ydyn nhw
seeds.english: they are people I don't know
seeds.korean: 그들은 제가 모르는 사람들이에요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn barod i siarad efo pobl dw i ddim yn nabod hyd yn hyn
seeds.english: I'm not ready to talk to people I don't know yet
seeds.korean: 저는 아직 제가 모르는 사람들과 이야기할 준비가 안 됐어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl bo’ fi wedi gwneud llawer mewn amser byr
seeds.english: I think that I've done a lot in a short time
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 짧은 시간에 많이 했다고 생각해요

seeds.welsh: os medri di siarad yn arafach, fyddai hynna’n wych
seeds.english: if you can speak more slowly that would be great
seeds.korean: 당신이 더 천천히 이야기할 수 있으면, 그건 정말 좋을 거예요

seeds.welsh: mae’n anodd meddwl yn ddigon cyflym i ateb mewn pryd
seeds.english: it's difficult to think quickly enough to answer in time
seeds.korean: 제때 대답할 만큼 충분히 빨리 생각하는 것은 어려워요

seeds.welsh: liciwn i gario ymlaen i wneud hyn am dipyn
seeds.english: I'd like to keep on doing this for a while
seeds.korean: 저는 이걸 한동안 계속하면 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: mae’n amser mynd rŵan
seeds.english: it's time to go now
seeds.korean: 지금 갈 시간이에요

seeds.welsh: dyma’r unig ffordd fydd o’n gweithio
seeds.english: this is the only way it will work
seeds.korean: 이것이 그게 작동할 유일한 방법이에요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti’n barod i fynd adre ar y bws nesa’?
seeds.english: are you ready to go home on the next bus?
seeds.korean: 당신은 다음 버스로 집에 갈 준비가 됐나요?

seeds.welsh: na, dw i ddim yn barod hyd yn hyn, dw i angen ychydig mwy o amser
seeds.english: no I'm not ready yet, I need a little more time
seeds.korean: 아니요, 저는 아직 준비가 안 됐어요, 저는 시간이 조금 더 필요해요

seeds.welsh: yndw, dw i’n barod i fynd cyn gynted â ti isio
seeds.english: yes I'm ready to go as soon as you want
seeds.korean: 네, 저는 당신이 원하는 대로 바로 갈 준비가 됐어요
seeds.note: Welsh yes/no echoes the verb (yndw, do, oes, ydy...); Korean 네/아니요 cannot carry which one. Course-wide

seeds.welsh: dylwn i ystyried chwarae rhywbeth arall
seeds.english: I should consider playing something else
seeds.korean: 저는 다른 걸 가지고 노는 걸 고려하는 게 좋겠어요
seeds.note: chwarae rhywbeth arall: sense (a game? an instrument?) unclear in both; rendered "play with". dylwn = -는 게 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: dylet ti ofyn i dy hun pam dydy o ddim yn gweithio
seeds.english: you should ask yourself why it's not working
seeds.korean: 당신은 그게 왜 작동하지 않는지 당신 자신에게 물어보는 게 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: ddylet ti ddim poeni am wneud rhywbeth tebyg
seeds.english: you shouldn't worry about doing something similar
seeds.korean: 당신은 비슷한 것을 하는 것에 대해 걱정하지 않는 게 좋겠어요
seeds.note: ddylet ti ddim = -지 않는 게 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n mwynhau ffeindio allan mwy am yr iaith ’ma
seeds.english: I'm enjoying finding out more about this language
seeds.korean: 저는 이 언어에 대해 더 많이 알아내는 것을 즐기고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dan ni’n trio deud fod o ddim fel ’na
seeds.english: we're trying to say that it's not like that
seeds.korean: 우리는 그게 그렇지 않다고 말하려고 노력하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dan ni ddim yn trio clywed llawer mwy o eiriau
seeds.english: we're not trying to hear many more words
seeds.korean: 우리는 훨씬 더 많은 단어를 들으려고 노력하고 있지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dan ni angen newid be’ dan ni’n gwneud
seeds.english: we need to change what we're doing
seeds.korean: 우리는 우리가 하고 있는 것을 바꿀 필요가 있어요

seeds.welsh: dyna pam doedd o ddim yn gwybod yr ateb
seeds.english: that is why he didn't know the answer
seeds.korean: 그것이 그가 답을 몰랐던 이유예요
seeds.note: dyna pam = 그것이 ~ 이유예요 (kept literal so 127 can mirror it)

seeds.welsh: dan ni ddim angen teimlo’n hapus, dan ni jesd angen gweithio’n galed
seeds.english: we don't need to feel happy, we just need to work hard
seeds.korean: 우리는 행복하다고 느낄 필요는 없어요, 우리는 그냥 열심히 일할 필요가 있어요

seeds.welsh: oeddan ni’n gobeithio gweld be’ oeddat ti’n gwneud
seeds.english: we hoped to see what you were doing
seeds.korean: 우리는 당신이 무엇을 하고 있었는지 보기를 바랐어요

seeds.welsh: doeddan ni ddim yn gobeithio deffro yng nghanol y nos
seeds.english: we didn't hope to wake in the middle of the night
seeds.korean: 우리는 한밤중에 깨기를 바라지 않았어요
seeds.note: HC Welsh keeps gobeithio (hope); the canonical English was changed to "expect" (C0108, #374) in other courses but not here. Translated the Welsh

seeds.welsh: rhaid i ni weithio’n galed i ddysgu llawer o eiriau newydd
seeds.english: we must work hard to learn a lot of new words
seeds.korean: 우리는 새로운 단어를 많이 배우기 위해 열심히 일해야 해요

seeds.welsh: dan ni’n ffrindiau, ac ar ôl i ni orffen liciwn i ymlacio
seeds.english: we're friends, and after we finish I'd like to relax
seeds.korean: 우리는 친구예요, 그리고 우리가 끝낸 후에 저는 느긋하게 쉬면 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: pan dan ni’n dysgu rhywbeth newydd mae’n newid ein hymennydd ni
seeds.english: when we learn something new it changes our brain
seeds.korean: 우리가 새로운 것을 배울 때 그것은 우리의 뇌를 바꿔요

seeds.welsh: oedd hynna’n ddiddorol iawn, a do’n i ddim yn disgwyl o
seeds.english: that was very interesting, and I wasn't expecting it
seeds.korean: 그건 아주 흥미로웠어요, 그리고 저는 그걸 예상하고 있지 않았어요

seeds.welsh: pam fedra i ddim cofio be’ ddudest ti?
seeds.english: why can't I remember what you said?
seeds.korean: 저는 왜 당신이 말한 것을 기억할 수 없어요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n teimlo fel taswn i’n gwneud yn waeth heddiw na ddoe
seeds.english: I feel as if I'm doing worse today than yesterday
seeds.korean: 저는 오늘 어제보다 더 못하고 있는 것처럼 느껴요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn teimlo fel taswn i’n barod i gael sgwrs
seeds.english: I don't feel as if I'm ready to have a conversation
seeds.korean: 저는 대화를 할 준비가 된 것처럼 느끼지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dydy hwn ddim y dewis gorau fedrwn i wneud
seeds.english: this isn't the best choice I could make
seeds.korean: 이건 제가 할 수 있을 최고의 선택이 아니에요
seeds.note: fedrwn i (could, conditional) vs medra i (can) both sit on -ㄹ 수 있다; -ㄹ 수 있을 is the nearest mark. Course-wide

seeds.welsh: dw i’n bendant yn gwneud yn well nag o’n i tro diwetha’ wnaethon ni siarad efo’n gilydd
seeds.english: I'm definitely doing better than I was last time we talked to each other
seeds.korean: 저는 우리가 지난번에 서로 이야기했을 때보다 분명히 더 잘하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n teimlo’n well nag o’n i’n teimlo pan oeddan ni yn y dafarn
seeds.english: I feel better than I felt when we were in the pub
seeds.korean: 저는 우리가 펍에 있었을 때 느꼈던 것보다 기분이 더 나아요

seeds.welsh: ga i ofyn rhywbeth i ti cyn i ti adael?
seeds.english: can I ask you something before you leave?
seeds.korean: 당신이 떠나기 전에 제가 당신에게 뭔가 물어봐도 될까요?

seeds.welsh: mae’n ddiddorol bo’ ti’n licio mynd ar y bws
seeds.english: it's interesting that you like to go by bus
seeds.korean: 당신이 버스로 가는 것을 좋아한다는 게 흥미로워요

seeds.welsh: mae’n anarferol bo’ ti ddim yn licio defnyddio dy gar
seeds.english: it's unusual that you don't like to use your car
seeds.korean: 당신이 당신의 차를 쓰는 것을 좋아하지 않는다는 게 특이해요
seeds.note: 당신 + 당신의 heavy; kept for dy

seeds.welsh: mae’n dechrau teimlo’n haws a dw i’n gyffrous am sut mae’n mynd
seeds.english: it's starting to feel easier and I'm excited about how it's going
seeds.korean: 더 쉽게 느껴지기 시작하고 있고, 저는 그게 어떻게 되어 가는지 설레요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl bod hynna’n syniad da
seeds.english: I think that's a good idea
seeds.korean: 저는 그게 좋은 아이디어라고 생각해요
seeds.note: syniad = 아이디어, kept apart from meddwl = 생각하다

seeds.welsh: o’n i’n meddwl bod hynna’n syniad da
seeds.english: I thought that was a good idea
seeds.korean: 저는 그게 좋은 아이디어라고 생각했어요
seeds.note: imperfect (o'n i'n meddwl) and preterite (wnes i feddwl) both = 생각했어요. Course-wide

seeds.welsh: dw i’n credu bod dy syniad di wedi bod yn dda iawn
seeds.english: I believe that your idea was very good
seeds.korean: 저는 당신의 아이디어가 아주 좋았다고 믿어요

seeds.welsh: mae’r gwaith ’ma’n newid siâp fy ymennydd i
seeds.english: this work is changing the shape of my brain
seeds.korean: 이 일은 제 뇌의 모양을 바꾸고 있어요

seeds.welsh: dim dyna pam o’n i isio gweld chdi
seeds.english: that isn't why I wanted to see you
seeds.korean: 그게 제가 당신을 보고 싶었던 이유는 아니에요

seeds.welsh: ti fel rhywun o’n i’n arfer nabod
seeds.english: you're like someone I used to know
seeds.korean: 당신은 제가 예전에 알던 사람 같아요

seeds.welsh: dw i mor hapus bo’ ti’n gwneud mor dda
seeds.english: I'm so happy that you're doing so well
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 그렇게 잘하고 있어서 정말 행복해요

seeds.welsh: oedd hynna’n syndod, achos mae o’n ffrind i mi
seeds.english: that was a surprise, because he's my friend
seeds.korean: 그건 놀라운 일이었어요, 왜냐하면 그는 제 친구이기 때문이에요

seeds.welsh: mae ’na ormod o syniadau’n mynd rownd yn fy mhen
seeds.english: there are too many ideas going around in my head
seeds.korean: 제 머릿속에 너무 많은 아이디어가 맴돌고 있어요

seeds.welsh: mae hynna’n llai cyffrous na be’ oedd hi’n deud
seeds.english: that's less exciting than what she was saying
seeds.korean: 그건 그녀가 말하고 있던 것보다 덜 흥미진진해요

seeds.welsh: ti’n dod i nabod rhywun yn dda iawn pan dach chi’n gweithio efo’ch gilydd
seeds.english: you get to know someone very well when you work together
seeds.korean: 당신과 누군가가 함께 일할 때, 당신은 그 사람을 아주 잘 알게 돼요
seeds.note: Welsh switches ti -> dach chi (you + them) mid-sentence; 당신과 누군가가 carries the chi. Clause order swapped to keep it natural

seeds.welsh: dydy hi ddim yn broblem pan ti’n gweithio ar rywbeth anodd efo nhw
seeds.english: it's not a problem when you work at something difficult with them
seeds.korean: 당신이 그들과 함께 어려운 것을 작업할 때 그건 문제가 아니에요

seeds.welsh: dw i ddim yn gwybod pam ti’n meddwl fod o mor dda
seeds.english: I don't know why you think that it's so good
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 왜 그게 그렇게 좋다고 생각하는지 몰라요

seeds.welsh: wrth gwrs gei di ofyn iddi hi achos mae hi’n ffrind i mi
seeds.english: of course you can ask her because she's my friend
seeds.korean: 물론 당신은 그녀에게 물어봐도 돼요, 왜냐하면 그녀는 제 친구이기 때문이에요

seeds.welsh: mae’n bwysicach siarad yn aml na bod yn berffaith
seeds.english: it's more important to talk often than to be perfect
seeds.korean: 완벽한 것보다 자주 이야기하는 것이 더 중요해요

seeds.welsh: fan hyn oedd fy ffrind isio cyfarfod ni
seeds.english: this was where my friend wanted to meet us
seeds.korean: 여기가 제 친구가 우리를 만나고 싶어했던 곳이에요

seeds.welsh: mae’n ddrwg gen i bo’ fi angen gadael mor gynnar
seeds.english: I'm sorry that I need to leave so early
seeds.korean: 제가 이렇게 일찍 떠날 필요가 있어서 미안해요

seeds.welsh: mae’n ddrwg gen i bo’ fi ddim yn medru gweld be’ ti’n trio dangos i mi
seeds.english: I'm sorry that I can't see what you're trying to show me
seeds.korean: 당신이 저에게 보여주려고 노력하고 있는 것을 제가 볼 수 없어서 미안해요

seeds.welsh: dim problem. mae popeth yn iawn
seeds.english: no problem. Everything is okay
seeds.korean: 문제없어요. 모든 게 괜찮아요

seeds.welsh: mae hynna’n garedig iawn ohonot ti a dw i’n ddiolchgar i ti am helpu
seeds.english: that's very kind of you and I'm grateful to you for helping
seeds.korean: 그건 당신이 정말 친절한 거예요, 그리고 저는 도와줘서 당신에게 고마워요
seeds.note: "kind of you" has no 해요 equivalent without -시- (친절하시네요); diolchgar = 고마워요, diolch = 감사해요

seeds.welsh: mae o’r un peth â be’ oeddan ni’n siarad amdano gynnau
seeds.english: it's the same thing as we were talking about earlier
seeds.korean: 그건 우리가 아까 이야기하고 있던 것과 같은 거예요

seeds.welsh: wnes i ddeffro’n gynharach nag o’n i isio bore ’ma
seeds.english: I woke earlier than I wanted to this morning
seeds.korean: 저는 오늘 아침에 제가 원했던 것보다 더 일찍 깼어요

seeds.welsh: pam dwyt ti ddim yn hapus bellach?
seeds.english: why are you not happy any more?
seeds.korean: 당신은 왜 더 이상 행복하지 않아요?

seeds.welsh: does dim byd i weld yn gweithio ers i ni drio’i drwsio fo
seeds.english: nothing seems to be working since we tried to fix it
seeds.korean: 우리가 그걸 고치려고 노력한 후로 아무것도 작동하지 않는 것 같아요

seeds.welsh: oedd hi’n garedig iawn pan welodd hi fi’n teimlo’n nerfus
seeds.english: she was very kind when she saw me feeling nervous
seeds.korean: 그녀는 제가 긴장하는 걸 봤을 때 아주 친절했어요

seeds.welsh: doedd o ddim yn amyneddgar iawn pan do’n i ddim yn medru ateb
seeds.english: he wasn't very patient when I couldn't answer
seeds.korean: 그는 제가 대답할 수 없었을 때 아주 참을성 있지는 않았어요

seeds.welsh: dydy hwn ddim yn anodd iawn, felly dw i’n gobeithio byddi di’n gorffen cyn bo hir
seeds.english: this isn't very difficult, so I hope you'll finish soon
seeds.korean: 이건 아주 어렵지 않아요, 그래서 저는 당신이 곧 끝내기를 바라요

seeds.welsh: fedri di ddeud wrtha i be’ ydy dy enw di?
seeds.english: can you tell me what your name is?
seeds.korean: 당신은 저에게 당신의 이름이 뭔지 말해 줄 수 있나요?

seeds.welsh: dim hynna o’n i’n gobeithio fyddai’n digwydd
seeds.english: that wasn't what I was hoping would happen
seeds.korean: 그건 제가 일어나기를 바라고 있던 일이 아니었어요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i wedi gwneud o’n wahanol ’swn i wedi gwybod be’ oeddat ti isio
seeds.english: I would have done it differently if I had known what you wanted
seeds.korean: 제가 당신이 원했던 것을 알았더라면, 저는 그걸 다르게 했을 거예요

seeds.welsh: fyswn i ddim wedi deud o’n union yr un ffordd
seeds.english: I wouldn't have said it in exactly the same way
seeds.korean: 저는 그걸 정확히 같은 방식으로 말하지는 않았을 거예요

seeds.welsh: lle wyt ti isio cyfarfod nos Sadwrn?
seeds.english: where do you want to meet on Saturday night?
seeds.korean: 당신은 토요일 밤에 어디에서 만나고 싶어요?

seeds.welsh: does dim ots gen i aros am ychydig funudau bore ’fory
seeds.english: I don't mind waiting for a few minutes tomorrow morning
seeds.korean: 저는 내일 아침에 몇 분 기다리는 것은 상관없어요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti isio mynd i fwyty heno?
seeds.english: do you want to go to a restaurant tonight?
seeds.korean: 당신은 오늘 밤 식당에 가고 싶나요?

seeds.welsh: fydda i ddim yn medru bod yno mis nesa’
seeds.english: I won't be able to be there next month
seeds.korean: 저는 다음 달에 거기에 있을 수 없을 거예요

seeds.welsh: gadewch i ni siarad am rywbeth arall
seeds.english: let's talk about something else
seeds.korean: 우리 다른 것에 대해 이야기하기로 해요
seeds.note: "let's" in 해요 (이야기해요) is identical to "we talk"; -기로 해요 is the least-bad clear form. gadewch is a chi form in a fixed phrase; Korean carries nothing of it

seeds.welsh: dim hynna dw i’n trio deud
seeds.english: that isn't what I'm trying to say
seeds.korean: 그게 제가 말하려고 하는 게 아니에요
seeds.note: trio deud = 말하려고 하다 here (말하려고 노력하다 reads oddly); harmless direction

seeds.welsh: sut wyt ti’n deud y gair ’ma yn y Gymraeg?
seeds.english: how do you say this word in Welsh?
seeds.korean: 당신은 이 단어를 웨일스어로 어떻게 말해요?

seeds.welsh: fedri di roi’r llyfr ’na i mi fore dydd Sul?
seeds.english: can you give me that book on Sunday morning?
seeds.korean: 당신은 일요일 아침에 그 책을 저에게 줄 수 있나요?

seeds.welsh: be’ ti’n meddwl am hynna?
seeds.english: what do you think about that?
seeds.korean: 당신은 그것에 대해 어떻게 생각해요?

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl fod o’n ddiddorol
seeds.english: I think that it's interesting
seeds.korean: 저는 그게 흥미롭다고 생각해요

seeds.welsh: llyfr diddorol
seeds.english: an interesting book
seeds.korean: 흥미로운 책

seeds.welsh: ond dw i ddim yn siŵr os ydy o’n wir
seeds.english: but I'm not sure if it's true
seeds.korean: 하지만 저는 그게 사실인지 확실하지 않아요

seeds.welsh: dydy fy enw i ddim yn anarferol iawn
seeds.english: my name is not very unusual
seeds.korean: 제 이름은 아주 특이하지는 않아요

seeds.welsh: be’ wyt ti angen gwneud pnawn ’fory?
seeds.english: what do you need to do tomorrow afternoon?
seeds.korean: 당신은 내일 오후에 무엇을 할 필요가 있어요?

seeds.welsh: ac wedyn mi fydda i’n medru dod i helpu nes ymlaen
seeds.english: and then I'll be able to come and help later on
seeds.korean: 그리고 그다음에 저는 나중에 도우러 올 수 있을 거예요

seeds.welsh: be’ wyt ti isio i mi wneud?
seeds.english: what do you want me to do?
seeds.korean: 당신은 제가 무엇을 하기를 원해요?

seeds.welsh: liciwn i i ti ddeud wrtha i be’ ti angen
seeds.english: I'd like you to tell me what you need
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 무엇이 필요한지 저에게 말해 주면 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti isio i mi helpu chdi chwilio amdano fo?
seeds.english: do you want me to help you look for it?
seeds.korean: 당신은 제가 당신이 그걸 찾는 것을 도와주기를 원하나요?

seeds.welsh: yndw, fyddai hynna’n help mawr
seeds.english: yes that would be very helpful
seeds.korean: 네, 그건 큰 도움이 될 거예요

seeds.welsh: na, dim diolch, mi fedra i ymdopi ar fy mhen fy hun
seeds.english: no thank you I can cope on my own
seeds.korean: 아니요, 고맙지만 괜찮아요, 저는 혼자서 해낼 수 있어요

seeds.welsh: fedri di ddallt be’ dw i’n deud?
seeds.english: can you understand what I'm saying?
seeds.korean: 당신은 제가 말하는 것을 이해할 수 있나요?

seeds.welsh: be’ wyt ti isio gwneud fore dydd Sul?
seeds.english: what do you want to do on Sunday morning?
seeds.korean: 당신은 일요일 아침에 무엇을 하고 싶어요?

seeds.welsh: mi wna i ofyn iddo fo os fydd o’n medru helpu flwyddyn nesa’
seeds.english: I'll ask him if he'll be able to help next year
seeds.korean: 저는 그에게 내년에 도와줄 수 있을지 물어볼게요
seeds.note: mi wna i = -ㄹ게요, kept apart from mynd i = -ㄹ 거예요

seeds.welsh: mi wna i ofyn iddi hi lle mae hi isio mynd
seeds.english: I'll ask her where she wants to go
seeds.korean: 저는 그녀에게 어디에 가고 싶은지 물어볼게요

seeds.welsh: ches i ddim amser, er bo’ fi isio gweld chdi
seeds.english: I didn't get time, although I wanted to see you
seeds.korean: 저는 시간이 나지 않았어요, 당신을 보고 싶었는데도요

seeds.welsh: be’ wnei di bnawn dydd Sul?
seeds.english: what are you going to do on Sunday afternoon?
seeds.korean: 당신은 일요일 오후에 무엇을 할 거예요?
seeds.note: wnei di (future) and wyt ti'n mynd i (going to) both = 할 거예요 in a question. Course-wide

seeds.welsh: liciwn i ddarllen fy llyfr am dipyn
seeds.english: I'd like to read my book for a while
seeds.korean: 저는 제 책을 한동안 읽으면 좋겠어요

seeds.welsh: ond rhaid i mi fynd â fy mam at y meddyg
seeds.english: but I have to take my mother to the doctor
seeds.korean: 하지만 저는 제 어머니를 의사에게 데려가야 해요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti wedi gweld fy ngoriadau i yn rhywle?
seeds.english: have you seen my keys anywhere?
seeds.korean: 당신은 어디에서 제 열쇠를 봤나요?
seeds.note: perfect (wyt ti wedi gweld) and preterite (welaist ti) both = 봤나요. Course-wide

seeds.welsh: na, mae arna i ofn bo’ fi heb eu gweld nhw
seeds.english: no I'm afraid I haven't seen them
seeds.korean: 아니요, 유감이지만 저는 그것들을 못 봤어요
seeds.note: heb (haven't) = 못 봤어요; 그것들 is translationese but carries nhw

seeds.welsh: do, weles i nhw yn y swyddfa ychydig yn ôl
seeds.english: yes I saw them in the office a while ago
seeds.korean: 네, 저는 조금 전에 사무실에서 그것들을 봤어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n meddwl bo’ ti wedi’u gadael nhw yn y gwaith
seeds.english: I think you left them at work
seeds.korean: 저는 당신이 그것들을 직장에 두고 왔다고 생각해요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti isio siarad am rywbeth gwahanol wythnos nesa’?
seeds.english: do you want to talk about something different next week?
seeds.korean: 당신은 다음 주에 뭔가 색다른 것에 대해 이야기하고 싶나요?
seeds.note: gwahanol = 색다른/다른 종류의, kept apart from arall = 다른 (seed 158); bare 다른 것 would admit both

seeds.welsh: dw i’n hapus hyd yn hyn
seeds.english: I'm happy so far
seeds.korean: 저는 지금까지는 행복해요

seeds.welsh: felly dw i ddim angen newid
seeds.english: so I don't need to change
seeds.korean: 그래서 저는 바뀔 필요가 없어요

seeds.welsh: ia, mae hynna’n syniad da
seeds.english: yes that's a good idea
seeds.korean: 네, 그건 좋은 아이디어예요

seeds.welsh: oes ots gen ti os dw i’n gofyn ychydig o gwestiynau i ti?
seeds.english: do you mind if I ask you some questions?
seeds.korean: 당신은 제가 당신에게 질문을 몇 개 하면 상관있나요?

seeds.welsh: na, does dim ots gen i o gwbl
seeds.english: no I don't mind at all
seeds.korean: 아니요, 저는 전혀 상관없어요

seeds.welsh: dw i’n brysur nos ’fory
seeds.english: I'm busy tomorrow night
seeds.korean: 저는 내일 밤에 바빠요

seeds.welsh: mae’n ddrwg gen i ond dw i’n rhy brysur heddiw
seeds.english: I'm sorry but I'm too busy today
seeds.korean: 미안해요, 하지만 저는 오늘 너무 바빠요

seeds.welsh: be’ wyt ti’n chwilio amdano?
seeds.english: what are you looking for?
seeds.korean: 당신은 무엇을 찾고 있어요?
seeds.note: identical Welsh to 68; same Korean is correct

seeds.welsh: dw i’n trio ffeindio’r pres wnes i adael ar y bwrdd
seeds.english: I'm trying to find the money I left on the table
seeds.korean: 저는 제가 탁자 위에 둔 돈을 찾아내려고 노력하고 있어요

seeds.welsh: wyt ti wedi clywed y syniad diweddara’?
seeds.english: have you heard the latest idea?
seeds.korean: 당신은 최신 아이디어를 들었나요?

seeds.welsh: mae fy mab yn gweithio fel athro
seeds.english: my son works as a teacher
seeds.korean: 제 아들은 선생님으로 일해요

seeds.welsh: mae fy merch yn gweithio i’r cyngor
seeds.english: my daughter works for the council
seeds.korean: 제 딸은 지방 의회에서 일해요

seeds.welsh: oedd fy ffrind yn arfer gweithio mewn swyddfa
seeds.english: my friend used to work in an office
seeds.korean: 제 친구는 예전에 사무실에서 일했어요

seeds.welsh: maen nhw’n deud bo’ nhw isio gwneud yn siŵr bo’ ni’n gorffen popeth mewn pryd
seeds.english: they say they want to make sure that we finish everything in time
seeds.korean: 그들은 우리가 모든 것을 제때 끝내도록 확실히 하고 싶다고 말해요
